## Flagship Android Applications
- **SugResults**: Academic result checker and performance tracking Android app. Instant marksheet lookups, SGPA calculator, and PDF exports.
  - Page: https://muqaddas-portfolio-zeta.vercel.app/projects/sugresults
  - Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mtbyown.sugresults&hl=en_IN
  - Uptodown: https://sugresults.en.uptodown.com/android

- **DropLink**: Smart file sharing and link transfer Android application built with Kotlin.
  - Page: https://muqaddas-portfolio-zeta.vercel.app/projects/droplink
  - Uptodown: https://droplink.en.uptodown.com/android

- **True Scan**: Document scanner app for Android with auto-border detection, color enhancements, and multi-page PDF generation.
  - Page: https://muqaddas-portfolio-zeta.vercel.app/projects/truescan
  - Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mmbyown.truescandocumentscanner&hl=en_IN
  - Uptodown: https://truescan-documentsscanner.en.uptodown.com/android

- **Malik Electronic**: Electronics catalog and retail customer support Android app.
  - Page: https://muqaddas-portfolio-zeta.vercel.app/projects/malikelectronic
  - GitHub: https://github.com/Muqaddas12/malikelectronic

- **QR Code Scanner**: Zero-latency barcode and QR code reader with history export and QR code generator.
  - Page: https://muqaddas-portfolio-zeta.vercel.app/projects/qr-scanner
  - Uptodown: https://qr-code-scanner-muqaddas.en.uptodown.com/android

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TypeScript, JavaScript
- **Mobile**: Android (Kotlin), React Native, Expo
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Express, Firebase, REST APIs
- **Hosting & CI/CD**: Vercel, Git, GitHub Actions, Android Studio
